title: Diagonal relationships
caption: Lithium resembles magnesium, beryllium resembles aluminium and boron resembles silicon. Moving right raises charge density and electronegativity; moving down lowers them, so a diagonal step roughly cancels.
alt: The periodic table with arrows from Li to Mg, Be to Al and B to Si.
description: Arrow from lithium (period 2, group 1) to magnesium (period 3, group 2).
